prompt:
Create ONE VFX texture sheet for Gemwoven, a polished jewel fantasy match-3 phone game, in the same luminous hand-painted VFX style as the attached reference sheet.

Canvas: wide 2:1 landscape, opaque PURE FLAT BLACK #000000 background, exactly 2 equal square cells side by side (left, right). No visible grid, borders, text, labels, gems, metal or scenery. Each effect is centred in its own cell, a PERFECT CIRCLE seen straight from above (not tilted, not an ellipse, not a spiral), and stays inside the central 82% of its cell with black margin all round; nothing touches a cell edge.

LEFT — Prism halo: one thin, perfectly round ring of rainbow light (red, gold, green, cyan, violet flowing evenly around the circle) with an ivory-white bright inner core line, its thickness EVEN all the way round, six small four-point star glints spaced evenly around it. Rotationally symmetric so it looks the same when it spins. Empty black centre.

RIGHT — Rainbow shockwave: one wide, perfectly round ring wave of prismatic light, thicker than the halo (about 1/7 of its diameter), bright ivory leading outer edge fading inward into soft rainbow bands, evenly spaced small sparkles riding on it. Rotationally symmetric. Empty black centre.

Screen-blend ready: saturated coloured light with crisp bright cores and restrained glow fading to pure black; no grey haze, no smoke.

precheck.summary: The candidate is a 1024x512 2:1 image with two centred rainbow rings on flat black, matching the prompt's layout. The left ring has six glints and the right ring has evenly spaced sparkles, and neither ring is cut off, has text, or shows a non-flat background. The rings' thickness and size are close to the requested proportions, so no clear objective defect was found.
